# Shop

**System**

Lets customers browse products and place orders.

The online shop. Owned by the Checkout team.

## Contains

- [Checkout API](checkout-api.md) (container) – Validates carts, reserves stock and takes payment.
- [Orders DB](orders-db.md) (container) – Stores orders and their status.
- [Web App](web-app.md) (container) – The storefront customers use.
